public_rationale: Marcus forecast that in 2026 home humanoids like Optimus and Figure would be 'all demo and very little product.' The forecast window ends on 2026-12-31, which is after the 2026-10-28 evaluation date. The only cited item is an eWeek report dated 2026-04-27 (e1). It said 1X NEO shipments were expected to begin in 2026 and that the first wave of robots would be partly controlled by teleoperation. That is context about a similar robot. It is not a year-end count. No item in the evidence documents thousands of humanoids delivered to consumer homes for regular use, so the early-contradiction rule is not met on this record. Under the contract, support can only be judged after the year ends.
limitations: The evidence includes no count of Optimus, Figure or NEO units delivered to consumer homes in 2026.
The only cited item covers 1X NEO, dated April 2026. No cited item covers Tesla Optimus or Figure directly.
Some sources were not used: one page returned no text, one was not read, and one was a low-authority aggregator.
'Very little product' has no numeric threshold, so the final call will need judgment.
The contract does not settle whether leased or teleoperated units count as product.

from_speaker: Human domestic robots like Optimus and Figure
will be all demo and very little product
our_interpretation: The forecast covers calendar 2026 (the post lists predictions 'for 2026').

Plain reading: by the end of 2026, humanoid home robots such as Tesla Optimus and Figure will be shown mostly in demos, with few units actually sold or delivered to ordinary consumers' homes for regular use.
Other home humanoids (for example 1X NEO) fall under 'like Optimus and Figure' and are relevant, but Optimus and Figure are the named examples.

Early resolution rule: contradicted early if, before 2026-12-31, reliable sources document thousands of humanoid robots of this kind delivered into consumer homes for regular use. Support can only be judged at the end of 2026.
criteria.support_condition: By 2026-12-31, consumer home deliveries of Optimus, Figure and similar humanoids are absent or tiny (pilot or early-access scale), while demos are plentiful.
criteria.contradiction_condition: During 2026, reliable sources document a substantial product: thousands of humanoid robots sold and delivered to consumer homes and used there regularly.
